from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents a paper in the collection, capturing its identity and outgoing references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this specific paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography (outgoing Reference relationship)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers to construct the citation graph."""
    papers: list[Paper]
